metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based product streams for the Online Retail Marketplace domain, covering shoppers, sellers, retail media, and marketplace foundations.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each experience carries only experience-specific flows. Each flow step lists the bricks and external systems used inside that experience.
